charges.label: Weight component
charges.quote: a weight component of ₹6.00 per kg of billed weight

charges.label: Distance component
charges.quote: a distance component of ₹2.00 per km of the booked lane distance

charges.label: Cold chain premium
charges.quote: carry a premium of 20% on the freight charge (the sum of the weight and distance components)

document_rules.rule: The c-note number quoted on each invoice line must correspond to a Customer booking; lines that cannot be matched to a booking are not payable until reconciled.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices.
A credit note references the original c-note number and the invoice it corrects, and must cover the full corrected amount.
Payment is due 21 days from invoice date.

ambiguities.description: The contract states that only standard service is offered under this agreement. It gives no rate for express service. If a shipment on this carrier is recorded with service_level=express, no rate is determinable from this contract.

notes: Freight = weight component (₹6/kg billed weight) + distance component (₹2/km) per §1. Cold chain premium of 20% on that freight sum applies when special_handling contains cold_chain (§3). Only standard service is offered (§2); no rate exists for express (ambiguity express_service_not_covered). The contract lists no accessorial schedule and never states that charges outside its schedule are unpayable, so accessorials_policy.closed_list is false (not an explicit closed-list clause, simply the absence of one). No invoice-level discounts are stated. Document rules capture unmatched-line non-payability, credit note requirements (§5-6), and the 21-day payment term (§4).
